title: Managing agricultural water use in the Western United States: A search for efficient climate adaptation institutions
abstract: Irrigated agriculture throughout much of the western United States relies on water resources that are under increasing stress from more frequent and severe droughts, reduced snowpack , and changes in the timing of runoff. Much of the water used for irrigation in that region passes through lands managed by irrigation organizations. These organizations play an important role in the use, allocation, and conservation of water resources through the maintenance of conveyance infrastructure, administration of rights to use water, and distribution of water to users. However, little work has been published to date systematically describing economic effects from alternative irrigation water trading arrangements for adapting to drought and climate change . The contribution of this work is to fill a gap in previous research by assessing the economic performance of various water trading arrangements for adapting to water shortages . We secured U.S. Department of Agriculture data on irrigation water use patterns in the central part of the Rio Grande Basin of the American Southwest to support formulation of a mathematical model predicting water use patterns to assess impacts on farm income associated with a range of water shortages and water trading arrangements for adapting to these shortages. Model results show that unlimited water trading minimizes farm income lost from shortages, while a more limited geographic scope for trading also moderates farm income losses. Among the three shortage sharing methods considered, a proportional sharing of shortages with no trading produces the greatest loss in farm income for adapting to shortage. These findings suggest that water trading arrangements have an important role play in adapting to water supply changes. Our results provide science-informed guidance to water managers, stakeholders, and policymakers tasked with discovering efficient water shortage adaptation plans for arid and semi-arid irrigation regions internationally.
abstract_zh: 美国西部大部分地区的灌溉农业所依赖的水资源，正面临日益增加的压力，包括更频繁、更严重的干旱、积雪减少以及径流时间的变化。该地区用于灌溉的大部分水，要经过由灌溉组织管理的土地。这些组织通过维护输水基础设施、管理用水权利以及向用户配水，在水资源的利用、分配和保护中发挥着重要作用。然而，迄今为止，很少有研究系统地描述不同灌溉水交易安排在适应干旱和气候变化方面所带来的经济效应。本研究的贡献在于填补这一研究空白，评估各种水交易安排在应对水资源短缺方面的经济绩效。我们获取了美国农业部关于美国西南部里奥格兰德盆地中部灌溉用水模式的数据，用以构建数学模型，预测用水模式，并评估在一系列水资源短缺情形及为应对这些短缺而采取的水交易安排下，对农场收入的影响。模型结果表明，不受限制的水交易能够最大程度地减少因短缺而损失的农场收入，而更有限的交易地理范围也能缓和收入损失。在所考虑的三种短缺分担方式中，在无交易的情况下按比例分担短缺，造成的农场收入损失最大。这些发现表明，水交易安排在适应供水变化方面具有重要作用。我们的结果为水管理者、利益相关方和政策制定者提供了基于科学的指导，帮助他们为干旱和半干旱灌溉地区（国际范围）设计高效的水资源短缺适应方案。

title: The development and current challenges of irrigated agriculture in the western U.S.
Federal drought assistance and adaptation decisions in the U.S. livestock sector
abstract: The increasing severity and duration of drought conditions has important implications for the agricultural sector, and particularly livestock producers, as drought can negatively impact profitability and forage availability. The USDA's Livestock Forage Disaster Program (LFP) aims to reduce the economic costs of drought by providing payments to livestock producers experiencing predetermined levels of drought. This paper assesses whether the program alters adaptation behavior and income among livestock producers. Our results suggest that the LFP does not significantly alter adaptation through herd retention and liquidation decision‐making, and it shows no significant impact on producer income measured as county‐level agricultural GDP.
abstract_zh: 干旱的严重程度和持续时间日益增加，对农业部门，尤其是畜牧生产者具有重要影响，因为干旱会损害盈利能力和饲草供应。美国农业部的牲畜饲草灾害计划（LFP）旨在通过向经历预设干旱程度的畜牧生产者提供补偿，降低干旱的经济成本。本文评估了该计划是否改变了畜牧生产者的适应行为及其收入。我们的结果表明，LFP并未显著改变其通过牲畜保留和淘汰决策所进行的适应行为，并且以县级农业GDP衡量的生产者收入也未受到显著影响。

title: Social comparisons and groundwater use: Evidence from Colorado and Kansas
abstract: In the United States, agriculture is responsible for the majority of consumptive water use. To reduce consumptive use in water scarce regions, policymakers have implemented a number of costly interventions. These interventions range from land retirement to subsidies that encourage the adoption of efficient irrigation technologies. In nonagricultural contexts, costly policy interventions have been complemented by low‐cost interventions inspired by behavioral economics. Whether these behavioral interventions are effective in the context of commercial farming is not well understood. In a preregistered, randomized field intervention, we estimate the impact of social (peer) comparisons on agricultural groundwater users in Colorado and Kansas. More than three thousand irrigators were randomized to receive either an annual peer comparison or no comparison. The peer comparison contrasted each irrigator's groundwater use to the distribution of use by neighboring irrigators. The comparison intervention reduced average annual groundwater use by 4.05% [95% CI (−5.87%, − 2.21%)], resulting in an aggregate reduction of more than 21,000 acre‐feet per year at a cost less than $1.31 per acre‐foot conserved. The estimated treatment effect was larger among irrigators with lower pre‐intervention water use. In the 3‐year experiment, we observed no evidence that the treatment effect substantially attenuated over time. We did, however, detect within‐irrigator spillovers in the treatment group: groundwater use also declined among wells that were not included in the peer comparisons (peer comparisons included a maximum of three wells). The results imply that social comparisons can be a cost‐effective tool, alongside other policy interventions, aimed at reducing agricultural water use.
abstract_zh: 在美国，农业占消耗性用水的大部分。为减少缺水地区的消耗性用水，政策制定者实施了许多成本高昂的干预措施，从土地退耕到鼓励采用高效灌溉技术的补贴不等。在非农业领域，成本高昂的政策干预已辅以受行为经济学启发的低成本干预。然而，这些行为干预在商业化农业中是否有效，目前尚不清楚。在一项预先注册的随机田间干预中，我们估计了社会（同伴）比较对科罗拉多州和堪萨斯州农业地下水使用者的影响。3000多名灌溉者被随机分配，接受年度同伴比较或不接受任何比较。同伴比较将每位灌溉者的地下水使用量与邻近灌溉者的用水分布进行对比。该比较干预使平均年地下水使用量减少4.05%（95%置信区间[−5.87%, −2.21%]），总计每年减少超过21000英亩英尺水量，每节约一英亩英尺的成本不到1.31美元。处理效应在干预前用水量较低的灌溉者中更大。在为期3年的实验中，我们没有观察到处理效应随时间大幅衰减的证据。然而，我们确实在处理组内发现了灌溉者内部的溢出效应：未纳入同伴比较的水井（同伴比较最多包括三口井）的地下水使用量也有所下降。研究结果表明，社会比较可以成为一种具有成本效益的工具，与其他政策干预一道，用于减少农业用水。

title: Impacts of block-rate energy pricing on groundwater demand in irrigated agriculture
The importance of well yield in groundwater demand specification
abstract: The implementation of effective resource management policies critically depends on accurate estimates of the price elasticity of resource demand. In the case of groundwater, previous research estimating well-level groundwater demand has largely ignored the importance of well yield, which is a physical limit on the rate of groundwater extraction. In this research, we empirically estimate the price elasticity of demand for groundwater using well-level data from Colorado. Our results demonstrate that when well yield is omitted, price elasticity is overestimated. This in turn creates inaccurate predictions of the effect of price-based conservation policies on groundwater use and welfare impacts.
abstract_zh: 有效的资源管理政策的实施，关键取决于对资源需求价格弹性的准确估计。就地下水而言，以往估计井级地下水需求的研究大多忽视了井的出水量的重要性，而出水量是地下水抽取速率的物理上限。在本研究中，我们利用科罗拉多州的井级数据，对地下水需求的价格弹性进行了实证估计。结果表明，若遗漏出水量，价格弹性会被高估。这进而会导致对基于价格的保护政策对地下水使用及福利影响的预测不准确。

title: Transition pathways to sustainable agricultural water management: a review of integrated modeling approaches
venue: Journal of the American Water Resources Association
abstract: Agricultural water management (AWM) is an interdisciplinary concern, cutting across traditional domains such as agronomy, climatology, geology, economics, and sociology. Each of these disciplines has developed numerous process‐based and empirical models for AWM. However, models that simulate all major hydrologic, water quality, and crop growth processes in agricultural systems are still lacking. As computers become more powerful, more researchers are choosing to integrate existing models to account for these major processes rather than building new cross‐disciplinary models. Model integration carries the hope that, as in a real system, the sum of the model will be greater than the parts. However, models based upon simplified and unrealistic assumptions of physical or empirical processes can generate misleading results which are not useful for informing policy. In this article, we use literature and case studies from the High Plains Aquifer and Southeastern United States regions to elucidate the challenges and opportunities associated with integrated modeling for AWM and recommend conditions in which to use integrated models. Additionally, we examine the potential contributions of integrated modeling to AWM — the actual practice of conserving water while maximizing productivity. Editor's note: This paper is part of the featured series on Optimizing Ogallala Aquifer Water Use to Sustain Food Systems. See the February 2019 issue for the introduction and background to the series.
abstract_zh: 农业水资源管理（AWM）是一个跨学科的议题，涉及农学、气候学、地质学、经济学和社会学等传统领域。这些学科各自发展出了大量基于过程的模型和经验模型用于AWM。然而，能够模拟农业系统中所有主要水文、水质和作物生长过程的模型仍然缺乏。随着计算机能力日益增强，越来越多的研究者选择整合现有模型以涵盖这些主要过程，而不是构建新的跨学科模型。模型整合寄托了这样一种希望：如同真实系统一样，模型的整体将大于各部分之和。然而，基于简化且不切实际的物理或经验过程假设的模型，可能产生误导性结果，无助于为政策提供信息。在本文中，我们利用来自高平原含水层（High Plains Aquifer）和美国东南部地区的文献与案例研究，阐明与AWM综合建模相关的挑战与机遇，并就适用综合模型的条件提出建议。此外，我们还考察了综合建模对AWM（即在保护水资源的同时实现生产力最大化的实际做法）的潜在贡献。编者按：本文是“优化Ogallala含水层用水以维持粮食系统”专题系列的一部分。该系列的导言和背景，请参见2019年2月刊。

title: Values and groundwater management in the Ogallala Aquifer region
venue: Journal of Soil and Water Conservation
abstract: The Ogallala Aquifer supports agricultural production and rural communities across eight US states, but the aquifer is being depleted in many areas. Depletion has continued despite numerous institutional and policy interventions, indicating that research and policy have not resulted in physical stabilization of the valuable common pool resource. We argue that explicit inquiry into the values motivating groundwater use and management is critical to conservation efforts. In this paper, we review and integrate prior social science research in the Ogallala region, drawing attention to areas where prior research considers values, implicitly or explicitly, and pointing to new or re-emerging areas for research into the relationship between human values and groundwater use, conservation, and management.
abstract_zh: Ogallala含水层为美国八个州的农业生产和农村社区提供支撑，但该含水层在许多地区正在被耗竭。尽管采取了大量制度和政策干预，耗竭仍在持续，这表明研究与政策并未实现对这一宝贵公共池塘资源的物理稳定。我们认为，明确探讨驱动地下水使用与管理的价值观，对于保护工作至关重要。在本文中，我们回顾并整合了Ogallala地区既有的社会科学研究，指出既有研究在哪些方面（隐含或明确地）考虑了价值观，并指出人类价值观与地下水使用、保护和管理之间关系的新兴或重新兴起的研究领域。

title: The heterogeneous impacts of groundwater management policies in the Republican River Basin of Colorado
abstract: Groundwater is a critical input to agricultural production across the globe. Current groundwater pumping rates frequently exceed recharge, often by a substantial amount, leading to groundwater depletion and potential declines in agricultural profits over time. As a result, many regions reliant on irrigated agriculture have proposed policies to manage groundwater use. Even when gains from aquifer management exist, there is little information about how policies affect individual producers sharing the resource. In this paper, we investigate the variability of groundwater management policy impacts across heterogeneous agricultural producers. To measure these impacts, we develop a hydroeconomic model that captures the important role of well capacity, productivity of water, and weather uncertainty. We use the model to simulate the impacts of groundwater management policies on producers in the High Plains aquifer of eastern Colorado and compare outcomes to a no‐policy baseline. The management policies considered include a pumping fee, a quantity restriction, and an irrigated acreage fee. We find that well capacity and soil type affect policy impacts but in ways that can qualitatively differ across policy type. Model results have important implications for the distributional impacts and political acceptability of groundwater management policies.
abstract_zh: 地下水是全球农业生产的关键投入。当前的地下水抽取量常常超过补给量，且超出幅度往往相当大，由此导致地下水枯竭，并可能使农业利润随时间推移而下降。因此，许多依赖灌溉农业的地区都提出了管理地下水使用的政策。即便含水层管理确有收益，人们对政策如何影响共享该资源的个体生产者仍知之甚少。在本文中，我们考察了地下水管理政策影响在异质性农业生产者之间的差异。为衡量这些影响，我们构建了一个水文经济模型，刻画了井容量、水的生产率以及天气不确定性的重要作用。我们利用该模型模拟地下水管理政策对科罗拉多州东部高平原含水层生产者的影响，并将结果与无政策的基准情形进行比较。所考虑的管理政策包括抽水费、数量限制和灌溉面积费。我们发现，井容量和土壤类型会影响政策效应，但其影响方式在不同政策类型之间可能存在质的差异。模型结果对地下水管理政策的分配效应和政治可接受性具有重要含义。
